scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate -w api && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api
scripts.start: npm run prisma:migrate:deploy -w api && npm run start -w api
